summary: FRONTEND-ONLY visual polish verification on /game/damma — END-TO-END PASS. The premium UI renders correctly: deep black luxury backdrop, wooden frame (LinearGradient WOOD_LIGHT→WOOD_MID→WOOD_DARK) around the green felt, gold-bordered 'ضمنة • Classic Game' title pill, green-glow active player card on the user (Tester avatar + score), gold-bordered turn-timer pill, wooden boneyard panel on the right with badge count (14) and 3-card stack, and wooden hand tray at the bottom. All UNDERLYING GAMEPLAY remains intact (verified — no regressions): 3-2-1 countdown plays, first tile placement animates from hand to felt, 'ends' updates from '— / —' to '1/3' → '1/4' after bot response, '🤖 thinking' indicator appears for ~5s on opponent turn, timer ticks 59→57 over 2.2s and continues every second, tile selection on non-empty board highlights the tile in gold/green and shows the gold 'right'/'left' side action button ABOVE the hand. Mode picker → رباعي (4 players) correctly spawns لاعب 2 (left), لاعب 3 (top), لاعب 4 (right) cards around the felt. Difficulty picker shows all three options (سهل/متوسط/صعب). Reset works (scores 0, board cleared, countdown replays). People-circle-outline header icon correctly navigates to /game/damma-lobby. NO red screens, NO console errors. The pre-existing untranslated i18n keys ('place_first_tile', 'your_turn', 'opponent_turn', 'ends', 'right', 'left', 'thinking', 'BONEYARD') are visible in the UI but per the agent-to-agent note this is PRE-EXISTING and explicitly NOT to be flagged as a regression.
action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) i18n dictionary is missing entries for keys: place_first_tile, your_turn, opponent_turn, ends, left, right, thinking, boneyard, tap_to_draw. They currently render as raw English keys (e.g., 'your_turn', 'BONEYARD'). The hardcoded `|| 'دورك'` fallbacks never trigger because t() returns the key/English instead of an empty string. Per agent-to-agent context this is intentionally out of scope for this UI polish — adding the Arabic strings to the i18n bundle would complete the localized look.

(Optional) None of the interactive elements in damma.tsx have testID attributes. UI testing here had to rely on x/y mouse coordinates and visible text. Future testing would be more robust if buttons (refresh, mode, difficulty, lobby, side action), tiles, and the boneyard had testIDs (e.g., `testID="damma-tile-${d.id}"`, `testID="damma-side-right"`, `testID="damma-boneyard"`).
critical_code_review_comments: damma.tsx is now 1180 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the wooden-frame/boneyard/hand-tray JSX blocks plus the modals into their own components in /app/frontend/src/games/damma/components/ to keep the screen focused on state wiring.

Hardcoded Arabic strings ('🤖 لاعب 2/3/4', '🤖 صعوبة البوت', '🎯 وضع اللعب', 'ثنائي (1 vs 1)', 'رباعي (4 لاعبين)') sit alongside t()-driven strings, mixing localization strategies. Future cleanup: move them into the i18n bundle so the same code can run in English / French.

Deprecated style warnings observed in expo logs but NOT introduced by this UI polish: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. These are pre-existing across the app, not caused by damma.tsx changes — but the wooden-frame styles do use shadow* heavily (e.g., `styles.timerBox`, `styles.boneyardBadge`, `styles.tileBack`) so future RN upgrades may force a migration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — premium visual upgrade verified: dark backdrop, gold title, wooden frame, felt, green-glow active card, boneyard panel, hand tray. Gameplay regression check 100% PASS: countdown, first-tile placement, ends-label update, 🤖 thinking ~5s indicator, timer tick-down, tile selection + side action button, 4-player layout with bot cards on top + 2 sides, difficulty/mode pickers, reset, lobby navigation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For /game/damma UI tests: log in via /login as testuser1/pass1234, then router.push('/game/damma'). Wait ~5s after navigate for the 3-2-1 countdown to clear. No testIDs are present in damma.tsx — selectors must rely on visible Arabic text (e.g., 'ضمنة', 'Classic Game', 'Tester'), or on body.innerText polling, or on raw x/y coordinates (the right-side icon cluster sits roughly at y=30, with x ≈ 280, 305, 335, 370 for lobby/mode/difficulty/refresh respectively on a 390-wide mobile viewport). The pre-existing un-localized strings (your_turn, BONEYARD, place_first_tile, etc.) are EXPECTED — do not regression-flag.
